# Preface

In the wake of EAC, it has become apparent that the ability for users to extend or improve client functionality is crucial, but also the ability for users to do so safely, without violating the sanctity or safety of the client application.

However, VRChat already has an extensive coding API which already allows players to extend worlds and their behaviors, doing many things on a world-level which modders had been doing on a client-level for some time.

This proposal is that Udon be variated and extended to provide add-on functionality as a result.

# Proposal

Udon, in all its forms (Node, Sharp, Assembly), could be extended to provide "Client Extensions" which would extend or improve existing functionality.

Udon-based client extensions could offer a subset of the Udon whitelisted features, whilst removing access to networking and world-based features, and adding client, UI, and local-player based access, including player-control without the need for OSC.

# Implementation

A new Client Extensions SDK would be provided, with a similar setup to the Avatar & World SDKs. A VRCClientExtensionDescriptor object would be applied to the root Game Object providing the extension's functionality. Udon Behaviors would then be added to the root, and optionally child objects, which then provide the extension functionality. Unique to Extensions, APIs to attach objects to the player, its joints, the launchpad, or the screen itself would be provided; along with APIs for player movement and manual armature manipulation or control. Further APIs to read Safety System configuration, temporarily override individual settings, and manipulate network player mute/visibility locally would be provided, alongside the ability to retrieve avatar ranking statistics from an network player's current avatar. APIs related to network synchronization and network player manipulation would be removed.

Post-processing would also be available, however, it would be severely limited on Quest hardware, with specific restrictions enforced. Likewise, a limitation on non-UI objects, such as tri-count, material renderers, and shaders, could be implemented to ensure performance.

Client extensions would be **local only**, and as such, would only be visible to the player with which they are installed. Likewise, in the event of a crash, extensions would be disabled via a "master switch".

Extensions would be submitted to VRC, and surfaced through a new extensions menu, complete with search, the ability to add/remove/toggle/report extensions, and the ability to enable/disable the extension system itself.
title: Implement Udon-based Client Extensions
